## Summary

**The analysis kernel grows the C1 op set.** `hh-analysis::ops`
dispatches A4 `frontier` (per-class frontiers + bands + combined —
never dominates across currencies), A5 `transfer`
(`TransferProfile{ratio per level, sign_stability,
conditionality_region, unknown_levels[]}` — `n/a` where Δ_in's
interval includes 0), A6 `benefit_decomposition` (the ADR-0046 three
rows + `search_baseline`, `LeakedSplit` on a post-search split hash),
A7 `fit_surface` (`unknown_cells` kept, never interpolated; `status`
re-derived at serve — `expired` on registry supersession), A9 `rank`
(task-resampled `rank_interval`s + `indistinguishable_sets` by
paired-Δ overlap — never a total order), A10 class-aware attribution
(`n/a{class}` on hosted rows, component-factor refusals on hosted
interactions), A11 `reliability_profile` (`pass_k` curve, horizon
`n/a` without task-time metadata, Wilson catastrophic rate), A13
`power` (pilot-simulated detectable Δ with declared estimator/seed/
draws) and A15 `diagnostics` (advisory, never alters a confirmatory
cell). Recorded reports serve by `report_id`, get-before-compute.

**The experiment engine enforces the producer contract.**
`producer_bind` + `record_analysis` + `verify`: `declare` after
`bind` is `DeclarationLate`, a second `declared` is refused, a
late `PreRegistration` is `PreRegistrationLate`, a comparison report
without `budget_match` is refused, `benefit_kind` mismatches refuse,
and `pre_registered` requires an identity-matching registration
(`NotPreRegistered`). Amendments mark later records
`post_amendment` (AC-R-2.10.5-10).

**The results store publishes.** `DisclosureSummary` counts
registered/published/restricted arms, exclusions and
pre-registered/exploratory analyses — restricted readers read the
status book, never the immutable manifest; unbound rows are
`undisclosed` under `require_experiment` (AC-R-2.10.5-8). The
annotation index carries `bundle_refs`, lifecycle flags and
leaderboard memberships — derived, rebuildable, never in row bytes.
`subscribe` is a durable-before-visible journal
(`RowHeadChanged | AnnotationChanged | SnapshotPublished`).
`export_rows` emits `ledger_native_rows` (lossless — round-trips to
equal `version_id`s) and foreign targets with a `LoweringLossReport`
naming every `no_slot` field (AC-R-2.10.5-11).

**Leaderboards persist.** `LeaderboardDefinition` registers as the
registry's 26th record kind (opaque arm, `hh-results`-owned schema)
with name history under ADR-0153 authority. Snapshots persist under
`snapshot_id = view_hash`; `diff_snapshots` reports entries added,
rank moves and flag changes — keyed on the row `key` so two rows
sharing a `configuration_id` never shadow each other — and
`entries_removed` stays empty under annotate-never-hide
(AC-R-2.10.5-4: `retract_entry` + member revocation + suite
retirement + blob GC leave every entry listed, flagged, and
`verify_row`-sound). `publish` lowers per ADR-0141, records the pin
set, and `gc` refuses `Pinned` on cited addresses.
